name: ToolDance X1
notes: Pre-launch: Kickstarter campaign announced for October 2026. Price is the VIP price 'starting at' USD 2,799, secured with a refundable USD 30 deposit on tooldance.ai; Super Early Bird on Kickstarter USD 2,999; stated MSRP USD 5,999. 3-axis standard; optional 4-axis and simultaneous 5-axis modules (5-axis module is a development preview). Air blast is standard, flood coolant requires an optional module. 9-tool ATC plus 1 workpiece probe, RFID tool ID, tool shanks 4/6/8/10 mm (max cutter 18 mm, tool length 35-100 mm); holder system not specified. Feed = rapid traverse (rated cutting feed 3,000 mm/min). Motors: NEMA 23 steppers with 14-bit absolute encoders and closed-loop FOC. Spindle 1.5 kW S1 PMSM, runout <=10 um @ 45 mm. Spindle camera + line laser for stock/fixture recognition.
